human-impacts-biodiversity-corridor.alt: Three panels. 1: one large forest with many animals. 2: a road and a farm split the forest into four small fragments, and fewer animals remain. 3: the same fragments reconnected by a wildlife bridge over the road and strips of habitat between patches, with animals moving among them again. Caption: small, isolated fragments hold fewer species; corridors let animals move, find mates and recolonize.
